title: REMAX Commercial Executive Director Recognized with Connect CRE Women in Real Estate Award
summary: Kristie Kimnach was honored for her leadership, innovation and contributions to the commercial real estate industry.
body_markdown:
As REMAX Commercial Executive Director, Kristie Kimnach has helped drive significant growth, expand global connections and create new opportunities for commercial professionals around the world. Those efforts recently earned her recognition as a recipient of


[Connect CRE’s 2026 Women in Real Estate Award](https://www.connectcre.com/awards/2026-women-in-real-estate-awards/national/) .


## 26-4845_2026_Women_in_Real_Estate_Award_Winner – Kristie Kimnach (2)


Kimnach leads the strategy, growth and global positioning of REMAX Commercial, overseeing initiatives that strengthen education, technology, partnerships and business resources for the network. She works closely with Broker/Owners, agents and regional leaders worldwide to increase engagement, expand commercial opportunities and support long-term growth.


Between 2022 and 2025, REMAX Commercial grew its commercial broker count by more than 32%, increased transaction activity by more than 18% to over 65,000 transactions and expanded the number of countries conducting commercial transactions from 69 to 76 under Kimnach’s leadership. The network also reports more than $18.5 billion in annual sales and leasing volume.


Among her accomplishments, Kimnach launched the REMAX Commercial Pro Series educational webinar program, reintroduced Commercial Deal Calls to encourage collaboration and referrals, and established new networking initiatives designed to strengthen connections among commercial professionals worldwide. She has also helped expand the brand’s commercial presence in emerging markets and fostered strategic relationships with leading industry organizations.


“Kristie’s vision, leadership and commitment to serving the commercial community continue to elevate REMAX Commercial around the world,” says Real REMAX Group COO Amy Somerville. “This recognition reflects the impact she has made across the REMAX Commercial network and throughout the industry.”


“I’m honored to be recognized by Connect CRE, but this award really reflects the strength and collaboration of the entire REMAX Commercial network,” Kimnach says. “Our focus has always been on creating meaningful opportunities for commercial professionals through education, connections and shared expertise. It’s incredibly rewarding to see the impact those efforts are having around the world.”


The Connect CRE Women in Real Estate award honors women whose talent, leadership and fresh ideas have helped them become influential voices in commercial real estate. Recipients represent a wide range of disciplines across the industry, including brokerage, finance, development, investment, asset management and real estate law.


Written by **REMAX News**
